```{r}
#| label: setup
source("_eiw-data.R")
library(knitr)

eiw <- eiw_load()
```

```{r}
#| label: derive
# No story-to-use-case column exists, so the link goes story -> requirement ->
# use case: a story shows against a use case when they share a requirement.
link_us_uc <- eiw$link_us_req |>
  filter(mark == "\u2713") |>
  inner_join(filter(eiw$link_uc_req, mark == "\u2713"),
             by = "req_id", relationship = "many-to-many",
             suffix = c("", "_uc")) |>
  distinct(us_id, uc_id) |>
  mutate(mark = "\u2713")

# The story ID already carries its category prefix.
stories <- eiw$user_stories |>
  mutate(prefix = substr(us_id, 4, 5))

prefix_to_category <- eiw$requirements |>
  mutate(prefix = substr(req_id, 1, 2)) |>
  distinct(prefix, category)
```

::: callout-important
## How to read these columns
A ✓ means the story and the use case share a requirement.
:::

::: panel-tabset

```{r}
#| label: story-tabs
#| output: asis
# Same tab structure as the requirements chapter so the two read alike.
for (cat_name in EIW_CATEGORIES) {

  pre <- prefix_to_category |> filter(category == cat_name) |> pull(prefix)
  grp <- stories |> filter(prefix %in% pre) |> arrange(us_id)

  if (nrow(grp) == 0) next

  cat("\n## ", pre[1], " — ", cat_name, "\n\n", sep = "")

  tbl <- eiw_tick_matrix(
    links   = link_us_uc,
    id_col  = "us_id",
    row_ids = grp$us_id,
    col_ids = eiw$uc_ids,
    col_key = "uc_id"
  ) |>
    left_join(select(grp, us_id, story, satisfies), by = "us_id") |>
    mutate(`User story` = paste0("**", us_id, "** ", story,
                                 "<br>*Satisfies: ", satisfies, "*")) |>
    relocate(`User story`) |>
    select(-us_id, -story, -satisfies)

  print(kable(tbl, align = c("l", rep("c", length(eiw$uc_ids)))))
  cat("\n")
}
```

:::

## Coverage

```{r}
#| label: coverage
# Column headings match the requirements chapter so both tables read together.
story_cat <- stories |>
  left_join(prefix_to_category, by = "prefix")

story_counts <- story_cat |>
  count(category, name = "Stories")

link_counts <- link_us_uc |>
  left_join(select(story_cat, us_id, category), by = "us_id") |>
  group_by(category) |>
  summarise(
    `Use case links`    = n(),
    `Use cases covered` = n_distinct(uc_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

story_counts |>
  left_join(link_counts, by = "category") |>
  arrange(category) |>
  rename(Category = category) |>
  kable()
```
